text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0836 CDT.

CANOLA - C$2.00 to C$3.00 a tonne lower on overbought sentiments, ideal growing weather and bearish CBOT soycomplex calls. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -3.70 Monday from +1.10 Friday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3671, up to 83.66 yen and 1.3137 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$1.00 to C$2.00 down on spillover pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$1.00 to C$2.00 lower on CBOT corn calls with the potential to drop further if commission houses do not resume covering shorts as they did Monday.
FEED WHEAT - C$1.00 to C$2.00 down on spillover pressure.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
